_note: Financial metadata policy; no compliance certification. TLS version controls require an explicit packet metadata interface. Deny-domain matches isolate the client's forwarded IPv4 traffic.

trading._note: Trading floor / high-frequency systems — tightest enforcement.

guest._note: Client / visitor WiFi. Deny-IP/Tor matches contribute a score; confirmed deny-domain matches isolate forwarded client IPv4.

dmz._note: Public-facing servers. SNI needs a metadata sensor; TLS version control requires an explicit packet interface.

collectors._zeek_note: Requires a separately provisioned Zeek sensor or packet interface for SNI; TLS version control uses the packet interface.
